purpose: Read the current study and support later coauthor work with traceable evidence. This is documentation, not executable analysis configuration.
conflict_handling: Treat this file as a dated navigation/status snapshot. Use current owner instructions and canonical documents; surface disagreements rather than silently changing definitions or relabeling old results.

owner_status_snapshot.main_figure_selection: F1-B and F2 selected for the working main figure set
owner_status_snapshot.abstract_drafting: deferred until a new owner instruction authorizes it
owner_status_snapshot.deadline_evidence: owner reconfirmation; not new portal verification
owner_status_snapshot.analysis_output_sharing: Reports, figures and aggregate result tables may be included in Git; raw/patient-level data and source-access secrets remain excluded.

clinical_evidence.availability: Versioned collaborator snapshot is included in a normal clone; no raw data are required to read it.
clinical_evidence.presentation_note: The saved scientific PDF embeds F1-A; standalone F1-B has identical values. Use B/F2 for the working main set. Older reports and CSVs retain their original pending-review wording; review_status.json and current decisions record subsequent owner approval separately.
clinical_evidence.execution_limit: Reading snapshot only, not a complete renderable run; the binary aggregate object and private receipts are omitted. Do not pass this package to make render.
clinical_evidence.if_unavailable: Obtain the versioned snapshot from this repository. State any evidence gap; never fill numerical claims from fixtures, older analyses, remembered counts or plausible estimates.

numerical_evidence.verify_first: Check clinical mode and analysis/schema identity in the package manifest. Verify each file against manifest.files[path].sha256 and its source_sha256 when present; the original bundle-manifest identity is recorded separately.

cohort_counts.instructions: Retain population_id, grain and status; overlapping outcome samples are not disjoint branches.

model_samples_and_failures.instructions: Use the matching model_id; never infer success from a plotted or missing row.

scale_rules.probability_and_PIF_fields: Stored as fractions: multiply by 100 when expressing percentages, including their confidence limits.
scale_rules.difference_per1000_fields: Already scaled per 1,000: do not multiply by 100 or 1,000 again.

numerical_evidence.writing_rule: Retain population, outcome, ascertainment window, reference, N, interval type and source table for every numerical claim. Report failure/unavailable states explicitly.
numerical_evidence.stage_key_note: population_id in cohort/descriptive tables identifies a stage within analysis_population_id; these fields are not universally interchangeable.
numerical_evidence.main_result_selection_rule: Apply the scalar main_result_filter AND restrict model_id to main_model_ids. The scalar filters alone also select matched-sample sensitivities, which are separate results.

interpretation_guardrails: One fixed first eligible patient index precedes gas availability and RFS partitioning; no later-index promotion.
Primary retains any non-OBESITY pathway including OBESITY overlap. Obesity-only is flow/audit only, without an adjusted comparison or weighting analysis.
Gas curves apply to outcome-evaluable patients. Known diagnosis capture is not ICD positivity; missing or unusable evidence is not negative.
The secondary policy is observed BMI >30 minus exactly one, no floor/reselection; BMI=30 is unchanged. PIF is conditional on the population and model.
Do not infer incidence reduction, causal weight-loss effects, untested-patient risk, or absence of selection bias. No current MAR/MNAR or IPW analysis.
Pointwise model-based intervals do not quantify selection or measurement bias; retain sparse/support warnings.

execution_navigation.latest_recorded_local_test_limits: Current same-day release checks and clinical qualification are recorded separately in WORKLOG.md; artificial results do not supply clinical estimates.
execution_navigation.boundaries: Reports, figures and aggregate result tables may be versioned for collaborator review. Do not include raw/patient-level data, identifiers, individual dates, model frames, individual predictions, credentials or source-access secrets. This guide does not authorize dependency installation, private-input access, refitting, changes to accepted evidence, unsolicited external messages or submission. Rendering uses saved aggregates only.
execution_navigation.package_integrity_check: See results/2026-10-18/README.md for the dependency-free Python SHA-256 verification command.
